newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Zywiec started as sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Zywiec started as sell.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said Thursday that analysts Murat Bahcivanoglu and Milto Goulandris had initiated coverage of Polish brewer Zywiec with a rating of sell.

-- Calling Zywiec shares "excessively overvalued," they wrote in a March 5 analysis, "We envisage a very tough environment for Polish brewers and do not expect Zywiec's earnings growth to outpace that of the overall Polish market in the intermediate term or to generate inspiring cash flow for the investor."
-- They set a 12-month price target for the stock of $67.40, representing a total return of 9.48 percent.
